name: Band Kneeling Single-Arm Pulldown
steps: Anchor a resistance band overhead, kneel facing the anchor, and reach up to grip the band firmly in one hand.
Brace your abs and set your torso upright with your working arm extended straight overhead.
Pull your working elbow smoothly downward toward your hip until your hand nears your shoulder.
Extend your arm slowly back overhead under tension, then switch sides after completing one arm.
tips: Keep both shoulders level rather than leaning sideways toward the pulling arm.
Initiate each repetition by drawing your shoulder blade downward before bending your elbow.
